target_customer: College athletic departments and football and basketball programs
problem: After athletes could earn income, programs must manage compensation budgets and roster limits with no tooling.
business_model: B2B SaaS sold to athletic departments
product_category: Front office software for college sports

founders.name: Luke Bogus
education: University of Nebraska Raikes School, computer science and marketing
founders.background_notes: Head of Product at Vial and product manager at Microsoft per the YC page.

founders.name: Nick Siscoe
founders.background_notes: Engineer at PayIt per the YC founder Q&A; education not listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Cap and roster modeling plus data integrations are standard SaaS with data partnership work.

defensibility.rationale: Adoption by 30+ programs, data partnerships with PFF, Hudl and Sports Info Solutions, and embedded workflows.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Teamworks sells roster and athlete pay products to college programs; no acquisition of Dropback found.

market_need_then: Athletes could earn NIL income from 2021 and rapid rule changes left programs managing compensation caps without tools.

identity.voice_and_tone: Sports front office language; FanCave, Inc. is the legal entity

brand_strength.rationale: Football term signals the market; partnerships announced with PFF (2024-11), Sports Info Solutions (2026-03) and Hudl (2026-08) and a podcast appearance show visibility.

pivots.to: AI workspace for college sports front offices
pivots.why: The 2026 homepage leads with AI teammates; the date of the shift is not sourced, so 2025 is approximate.

outcome_analysis: Dropback rode the NIL rule change and now reports 30+ teams across the ACC, Big Ten, Big East and SEC, with data partners PFF, Hudl and Sports Info Solutions. It looks like a company with product market fit in a niche. Funding is only reported by a newsletter and no later round is verified.
notes: Funding unverified: a sports tech newsletter (The 4th Quarter, March 2025) reports $1.6M from Y Combinator, Reach Capital and Twenty Two Ventures; I could not open it or find a second outlet, so no round recorded. The name meaning was not sourced. Competition: the one result naming Teamworks was undated or 2026, so the list is empty as of founding. The Dropback name origin is not stated in any source.
